result.summary: Found 1 issue: a section heading displays an untranslated localization key instead of readable text.

issues.description: The section heading below 'Fastest near you' shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the missing translation for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key (e.g., 'Popular near you') so the heading renders proper text.
